model_specification: Phase 28 combined lean vNext; raw identity-calibrated probabilities; neutralized I1 player rates; no home_team nuisance
selection_reason: 365-day challenger is worse pooled after a large 2025 reversal. 1460-day challenger has a ~5.6e-6 pooled game-weighted advantage but worsens 3/4 development seasons and is indistinguishable from baseline by paired-date uncertainty. Precommitted parsimony/stability rule retains baseline.

replication_2026.reason: No non-baseline challenger cleared the development selection gate; 2026 remains untouched rather than being consulted to break a development tie.

conclusion: Current direct-I2 regularization and recency hyperparameters survive the audit. No retune.
next_phase: Prioritize Phase 30B leakage-safe as-of arsenal freshness, which has a substantially larger and more consistent oracle upper bound than any hyperparameter alternative.
